thread:
Maria: Starting cutover sync for the change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Quick checklist: model pin, infra pin, DB migration, canary plan, rollback commands. Any blockers?
Aj: I need to confirm Dedicated pool pin for gpu-pool-b. I’ll lock capacity by EOD and post the commit id.
deploy-bot: change-window created cw_20260321_02 (2026-03-21T02:00:00Z) — owners: @Maria, @Aj — reminder scheduled 1h before.
Olivia: DB migration 'add_inference_stats' is backwards-compatible. Plan: run rolling dry-run jobs at T+0, enable feature flag db_mig_20260321=false during canary, flip to true after 50% if clean. @Sam please validate dry-run logs.
Sam: running dry-run now. Snippet: `migration dry-run: 0 errors, 42,138 rows scanned` ✅ Will post final verification by 22:00 PT.
Kevin: Rollout plan proposal: canary 10% (infer-canary group, 4 pods) for 15m -> 50% for 20m -> 100% cutover. Performance gates: p50 latency < 250ms AND error rate < 1% over the window. Abort criteria if either breached. Rollback commands below.
Kevin: ```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=43
# or via control-plane API
curl -X POST "https://ops.redwood/api/v1/rollbacks" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"deployment":"inference","target":"release-2026-03-14"}'
```
Aj: Pinning details: container image -> `redwood/inference:release-2026-03-21-1`, model -> `model-x@v2.3-quant` (pinned in routing table). I pushed the pin to repo: infra/configs/releases/2026-03-21/pins.yaml sha: b7f4c9a.
Maria: Adding fallback behavior: if canary fails auto-route to `model-x@v2.2-stable` and enable caching-bypass flag `inference_cache_bypass=true` for 10m while we investigate. Ops playbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/cutover-2026-03-21 (contains step-by-step rollback and DB migration rollback notes).
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z (1h prior) and 2026-03-21T01:45:00Z (15m prior).
Sam: Oncall check — @Kevin you have oncall handoff at 01:30 UTC, can you confirm?
Kevin: Confirmed. I’ll be primary oncall until 03:30 UTC. If immediate rollback needed, @everyone call #oncall and follow the playbook. I’ll run the rollback command if paging hits.
Maria: One more: feature-flag toggles are staged in FF service: `db_mig_20260321`, `inference_cache_bypass`, `model_route_fallback`. I'll flip them via the console, but Ops can override.
Aj: No blockers from infra. Capacity pin applied. I'll monitor GPU utilization during canary and adjust autoscale thresholds if needed.
Maria: OK — final signoffs: @Aj, @Olivia, @Kevin, @Sam. If no objections by EOD, we proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:
